thread:
michaela_cs: Quick heads-up — Orchid Labs renewal is mostly signed but procurement says e-sign is blocked by their compliance team. they insist on a wet signature + invoice to a different legal entity. can we route this without delaying the Apr 1 start?
jordan_am: Ugh. timeline is tight. customer expects activation Apr 1. do we have a one-off process for wet-signed docs? :grimacing:
michaela_cs: They sent PO 4421 and want invoice to "Orchid Labs EU Ltd" (different tax id). vendor code they requested: V-ORCH-EU. also asking for KMS mention removed from SOW (redaction) — legal wants to confirm.
leo_finance: We can invoice a different billing entity as a one-off, but need vendor code + VAT/tax id + signed agreement scanned. pls confirm whether this is invoicing-only or requires account entity migration. net terms stay the same?
nina_ops: If it's invoicing-only we can avoid moving the account. ops needs the exact billing entity name and tax id for our billing system. also if they insist on wet signature we need a scanned PDF uploaded to the contract record.
michaela_cs: Confirmed: invoicing-only, net30 stays. customer will provide scanned wet-signed PDF of the amendment. they're delaying e-sign due to their notary requirement.
sam_engineer: heads-up: Dedicated commit (GPU) included in renewal — if we change entity on invoice, no infra change. for the KMS redaction, we'll need to attach an addendum to the SOW. i can draft the addendum today.
leo_finance: ok send vendor code + tax id and the scanned doc to billing@redwood.com. i will queue invoice creation as soon as we have the wet-signed PDF. note: for EU entity we need VAT number or else invoice will be treated differently.
legal-bot: Per policy, wet-signed amendments are acceptable if they contain the executed signature page + the amendment reference (renewal id 57841). DocuSign fallback guidance: we prefer executed e-sign but will accept scanned wet signatures for regulated customers. please add the following to the contract record: template-id:t-renewal-2025-03 and upload scanned PDF.
legal-bot: Quick checklist:
``
- signed amendment (scanned PDF)
- exact billing entity name + tax/VAT id
- PO number (4421)
- redaction request: remove KMS mention from SOW or add KMS-suppressed clause
```
jordan_am: i'll collect the vendor code + VAT from the buyer this morning. will ask them to upload the scan to DocuSign for traceability and also email it to us. tagging @michaela_cs to coordinate. :pray:
michaela_cs: thanks. once i have the scan and vendor code i'll drop them in this thread and ping billing. if billing needs anything else i can get an exec sponsor to nudge procurement.
leo_finance: FYI — i will mark this as "manual invoice" in the system and set expected invoice generation: 2025-04-01. please get the scan by EOD tomorrow to hit that.
nina_ops: ops will accept the scanned PDF and attach to contract. if the customer later requests account migration we can handle that as separate ticket.
sam_engineer: drafting SOW addendum now. placeholder snippet below for legal:
``
Addendum: KMS references removed for Orchid Labs EU Ltd per customer request. Redwood will not store or reference customer-managed KMS in the public SOW; any KMS integration to be covered in a separate order form.
```
legal-bot: looks good, but we need to change "not store" wording to "not include specific KMS configuration details in the public SOW". i'll patch the language when you share the draft.
michaela_cs: i'll update once jordan hands me vendor code + VAT. flagging internal follow-ups: billing, legal signoff, ops attach doc. will update the queue. :white_check_mark:
